title: Euclidean Hausdorff measure of a disc in a linear subspace
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let Q ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim Q = n (Module.finrank ℝ Q = n), let y ∈ Q and ρ > 0. Then H^n(Q ∩ B_ρ(y)) = ω_n·ofReal(ρ^n), where H^n = μHE[n] is Mathlib's Euclidean-normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P and ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball of ℝ^n.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n → y ∈ Q → 0 < ρ → μHE[n] ((Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball y ρ) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)
